notes: Guide/walkthrough source candidates. approved=false on all; no posting or OpusClip submission done. Stats from yt-dlp flat channel /videos (last 14 uploads, approximate_date): subs = channel_follower_count, avg views = mean of newest 10 uploads, uploads_per_week = (n-1)/span of the sampled uploads (overstates when sample is bursty), gta6_posts_last14d = titles mentioning GTA 6/VI/Grand Theft Auto 6 within 14 days of 2026-11-16 (all are pre-launch trailer/tips/speculation, not real gameplay). chapters = count on newest >5 min upload. Reuse policy: only lines found via regex over About + latest description; none of these state a clip/reuse policy. Rockstar/Take-Two policy page could not be fetched (JS/404); no verified guidance, treat as unknown. Not checked: COLETHEMAN GTA (8.9k subs, 299k avg, 5 G6 posts, 2.3/wk; chapters/policy unchecked), ABTW (8.5k subs, 146k avg, 5 G6 posts; unchecked), ZacCoxTV (863k subs, 52k avg, 0 G6 posts 14d, easter eggs), Sunset Stacks and Vice Lineup (no channel id).
